The phone screen stays dark from the first frame to the last, an unlit slab with no glow. Everything else remains still and the light stays constant.
takes.verdict: 채택 — 5초판 잠정 채택(t3) — 2.5s 부근 화면이 한 번 번쩍임(t2보다 줄었으나 남음) · 손·카메라·배경은 안정(SSIM 0.89) · t4 결과가 나으면 교체

takes.prompt: Locked-off tripod shot. Both hands keep holding the phone in the same place with the thumbs resting on its side edges, away from the screen; only a small restless tilt of the wrists at natural speed. The phone screen stays dark for the whole shot and the only light in the frame comes from the window. Everything else remains still and the light stays constant.
takes.verdict: 채택 — Claude 판정 통과 — 5초판 · 화면 번쩍임 해소(t2 여러 번 · t3 1회 → t4 0) · 엄지를 화면에서 떼고 '유일한 빛은 창' 문장 추가 · 손·카메라 안정(SSIM 0.84)
